timing_category_rule.during: cumulative 25% step <= trigger step <= cumulative 75% step

primary_perception_signal: equal-scale L2 of existence, bearing, proximity, confidence, centroid, bbox, and component-count changes
primary_control_signal: Euclidean norm of held-versus-current left/right wheel commands
analysis_boundary: Timing definitions use diagnostic signals only. Clearance, contact, collision, and task success enter only the later P4 trade-off diagnosis.
